note: Optional recordings for presentable renders, all CC0 except the University of Iowa recordings, which their publisher makes free for any use without restrictions. Archives are fetched only from the listed official hosts and must match size and SHA-256; only the listed members are extracted. Builds fetch sample files one by one from a pinned commit, check each against its git blob hash and must reproduce the output hash; the files a build takes are pinned too (samples_sha256: each path with its blob hash and size), so a source listing that names other files, or other paths, is refused before anything is fetched, and each file is fetched up to its locked size. Hashes are integrity checks, not antivirus results. The Iowa builds fetch each recording from the University of Iowa site, check its size and SHA-256 recorded at retrieval, cut every note where the notes manifest records it, check each note's hash and must reproduce the output hash.

prebuilt.note: The banks under builds as this project built them, each SF2 compressed with xz and attached to the repository's release soundbanks-1. An asset must match its size and SHA-256 before it is opened, may not unpack past sf2_bytes, and must unpack to the build's output_sha256; otherwise, or when the release cannot be reached, fetch_soundbanks.py builds the bank from its sources. The banks under archives (published as SF2 in .7z files by FreePats and Andrea Biasior) are repacked unchanged as tar.xz on the same release ("archives" here): an asset must match its size and SHA-256 and give the bank's member_sha256; otherwise, or when the release cannot be reached, the publisher's own archive is used.
